tactics: rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with h | h
cases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with | inl h => simp [h] | inr h => simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right h hb
cases a with | zero => simp | succ n => simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) hb
obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, b = k + 1 := ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩
induction b with | zero => omega | succ k ih => cases k with | zero => simp | succ j => rw [Nat.pow_succ]; exact Nat.le_trans (ih (by omega)) (by cases a <;> simp [Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right])
